Sora2.prompt: Cinematic static locked-off shot in ancient Chinese anime style. Through a weathered wooden door frame, a burly bearded Chinese man in brown martial attire, with tanned skin and full beard, blocks the doorway with an angry expression, torchlight illuminating his face from the right side creating warm yellow glow. He shouts with pointing finger, accusing a young woman in pale green ruqun dress of poisoning her master. The young woman, 18 years old with long flowing black hair, looks terrified and trapped in the center of the door frame. He shoves her forcefully backward with his arm. She stumbles back into the dark room with panic in her eyes, tears welling up. The door frame creates a prison-like composition, trapping her with no escape. Warm torchlight from outside contrasts with cold blue lighting inside the room. 50mm lens at f/2.8, medium shot, eye-level angle. Hexagonal bokeh on background firelight, lens flare from torch. Angry confrontation, accusation of adultery and poisoning, no escape, power imbalance.

SeeDance.prompt: 古风动漫风格，电影感固定镜头。透过破旧木门框构图，霍齐，身材魁梧的中年男子，络腮胡，皮肤黝黑，身穿深褐色短打，堵在门口，火把光芒从右侧照亮他愤怒的面容。他右手指点，咆哮着指责辛月影毒害主公、私通王屠户。辛月影，18岁少女，身穿淡青色交领襦裙，长发凌乱，被困在门框中央，表情惊恐无助，瞳孔收缩。霍齐一把将她推回房间，她踉跄后退，跌入黑暗的屋内，眼中泛着泪光。门框形成天然牢笼，象征无路可逃。门外火把暖黄光与室内冷蓝光形成强烈对比。50mm镜头，光圈f/2.8，中景，平视角度。六边形焦外光斑，火把产生的镜头光晕。愤怒对峙，冤屈难辩，退路被封。
